description: List the BMC profiles saved in OldIPMI: id, name, host, family, username and whether a password is saved. Never returns passwords.
name: list_profiles
title: List BMC profiles

description: Several consoles can be open at once. Always lists them in sessions (profile, state). For one console (the profile argument, or the only open one): connection state (disconnected, logging_in, discovering, connecting, connected), status message, profile, console info, mounted ISO, framebuffer size and screen-change counters. Also whether a password prompt is waiting for the user. With several open and no profile this is an error that names them.

profile.description: Which open console to act on: profile name, id or host. Optional while exactly one console is open; required when several are (see status → sessions).

name: status
title: Console status

description: Open the console of a saved profile (by name, id or host) and wait until it is connected with a first frame, or report the failing stage. Uses the password saved in KWallet. If none is saved, OldIPMI asks the USER for it in its window; this tool keeps waiting for that (password_wait_ms) — tell the user to type it there. Other consoles that are already open stay open (several can be open at once; address each with the profile argument of the other tools). Calling connect again for the profile that is already connecting or connected just waits for it.

password_wait_ms.description: Time to wait for the user to enter a missing password in the OldIPMI window, default 60000; 0 = do not wait

profile.description: Profile name, id or host (see list_profiles)

timeout_ms.description: Time allowed for login and console setup, default 45000

name: connect
title: Open console

description: Close one console session (profile argument, or the only open one), or cancel one that is being set up (also dismisses a pending password prompt). all=true closes every open console. Other consoles stay open.

all.description: Close every open console instead of one

profile.description: Which open console to act on: profile name, id or host. Optional while exactly one console is open; required when several are (see status → sessions).

name: disconnect
title: Disconnect console

description: PNG image of the remote screen (returned as MCP image content). Optional crop region in framebuffer pixels, and downscaling: scale (0.1..1) and/or max_size (longest image side, default 1568; 0 = full resolution). The text block states the exact mapping; all other tools always take FRAMEBUFFER coordinates.

max_size.description: Longest side of the returned image in pixels, 64..4096, default 1568; 0 = no limit

profile.description: Which open console to act on: profile name, id or host. Optional while exactly one console is open; required when several are (see status → sessions).

name: screenshot
title: Screenshot

description: Block until the remote screen content changes, or until the timeout. Use after an action whose effect takes time (boot, menu redraw).

profile.description: Which open console to act on: profile name, id or host. Optional while exactly one console is open; required when several are (see status → sessions).

name: wait_for_change

description: Block until the remote screen has not changed for quiet_ms, or until the timeout. Use after input before taking a screenshot.

description: Type text on the remote keyboard as a US-layout keyboard would: every printable ASCII character (Shift added where needed), newline = Enter, tab = Tab. The remote OS keymap must be US for symbols to come out right; CapsLock on the remote inverts letter case.

delay_ms.description: Pause after each key event, default 8; use 30-50 for slow BIOS screens

profile.description: Which open console to act on: profile name, id or host. Optional while exactly one console is open; required when several are (see status → sessions).

name: type_text

description: Press and release one key or a '+'-joined combination, e.g. Enter, Esc, F2, Down, PageDown, Delete, KP_Enter, ctrl+alt+delete, alt+sysrq+b, ctrl+alt+f1. Optional repeat. Call list_keys for all names.

hold_ms.description: How long the key is held, default 50

name.description: Key name or combination of up to 6 keys
